note: Campground in the woods behind a bar and grill on WI 35 in Lewis, north of Frederic, with an outdoor bar, live music on summer weekends, and the Gandy Dancer State Trail across the road. Many sites are leased by the season. --Claude
summary: Operator campground page read: water/electric $50 a night confirmed (2026-27), no-hookup $35, weekly/monthly rates, $5 per extra person over 4; phone booking; seasonal term Apr 15-Oct 15 (2027 seasonals sold out). Price at the gate line; nightly share unmeasured - long-stay flag. Google 4.7 (234).
flags: PRICE GATE: $50 a night for a water and electric site (operator, '2026-27 Camping Rates') - at the line, not over. No-hookup sites are $35, but the page doesn't say an RV may use them. Google 4.7 (234, the listing is shared with the bar). Presence: operator website + phone.

LONG-STAY (reviewer): the page sells nightly, weekly (7 nights) and monthly (30 nights) and says '2027 SEASONAL SITES April 15 - Oct. 15 SOLD OUT'. A camper blog linked from the operator's home page (Aug 2026) says 'there's a waiting list to lease one for the summer ... Sundown welcomes overnight and short-stay RVers too' and 'Call ahead to check availability, especially on summer weekends' (the blogger's wording, not the operator's). The nightly share couldn't be measured: no site map, and imagery under canopy shows only some scattered units east of the bar. Nothing from the operator discourages nightly guests.
HOOKUPS: stored electric 30 / water / sewer (derived) left. The operator's rates name only 'Water & Electric'; the blog says 'full hookup - water, electric, and sewer'. Amperage not found.
SITES: count 31 (derived) left - no count on the pages read.
PIN: stored 45.7143,-92.3960 is on the bar lot by WI 35; the campground lies just east under trees (~45.7145,-92.3940). ~150 m - fine.
